fnol_text: My name is Owen Thorne and I live at 792 Linden Lane, Clinton, NC 28363. You can reach me on (555) 421-7007 or owen.thorne@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 14 December 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00065. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Thorne on (555) 421-7007 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 14 December 2025.
Site visit to 792 Linden Lane. Neighbour Viktor Abernathy was present and confirmed the timeline.
Owen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
